en: A black and white photograph of a large, multi-story institutional building with a steep tiled roof and many windows. The architecture features a modest decorative cornice near the roof and a small tower structure visible in the background, suggesting early 20th-century European influence. There are people, including children, standing and walking along a tree-lined street in front. The building is surrounded by a fence. In white script at the bottom left of the image, text is visible.
